suggested_fix: No fix required. The TX channel index is bounded by the number of configured TX channels (cpu % common->tx_ch_num), so the tx_chns array cannot be indexed out of bounds. Concurrent transmissions on the shared TX queue are serialized with __netif_tx_lock/__netif_tx_unlock. Frames that are not sent are left to the caller, which handles them through the returned nxmit count.
